decisions.reason: As the modular continuation of the already successful BASIC 518, this product fits the core portfolio and its continued presence after several years suggests low-cost option value has largely turned into a validated offering.
The multi-model mobile flail shredder line sits squarely in the firm's core mobile processing business, and after remaining in the portfolio for years it is more likely to be refined than withdrawn.

Although this grinder line had weaker initial market signaling than products with a dedicated page, its survival to 2022 indicates enough customer acceptance to justify keeping the option open rather than exiting now.

The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line is a serious adjacent platform with dedicated presentation and strong fit to the firm's waste-processing systems business, so near-term abandonment is unlikely.
